subject: social
title: Cause & effect
blurb: Read an event, then analyse it.

config.title: The Dry Year
config.passage: One year, very little rain fell on the farms for many months. The crops dried up and there was not enough food. Prices in the market rose sharply, and many families had to travel far to find work and water.

questions.prompt: What was the main CAUSE of the problem?
What was an EFFECT of the drought?
choices: Crops dried up and food was scarce

questions.prompt: Why did prices in the market rise?
choices: Food was scarce, so it cost more
